title: Ballad playing on trombone and Goodbye Rose
summary: Ballad trombone existed early; he remembers a beautiful trombone solo on Goodbye Rose played by a man he cannot name.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: But ballad playing now, did that -- that wouldn't have been around when you started in that sense, would it?
Sure. Yeah. I remember a long while ago, a trombone player -- I don't remember who he was -- but there was a piece called 'Goodbye Rose.' And it was just a beautiful trombone solo this guy played.
Yeah. And that was a beautiful number.
But you have no recollection of that --
I think that he used to -- I think that quartets used to sing it years ago. Quartets. Of course it was just a 16 measure thing. But I can remember that sound of the trombone playing. It was good.
